output.summary: A deciduous shrub native to the Himalayas and southwestern China. Its hanging clusters pair small pale flowers with purple-pink bracts, followed by berries that become soft, sweet and deep purple-brown when ripe; unripe berries are unpleasantly bitter.
output.edibilityNote: Only soft, ripe, deep purple-brown berries are described as sweet and edible; unripe berries are unpleasantly bitter.
